name: useSecurity
summary: Encrypted storage for secrets, backed by hardware.
plain: Where API keys and tokens belong. Values are encrypted with a key the operating system holds in secure hardware, so they are not readable from app storage. Never put a secret anywhere else.
description: Wraps expo-secure-store, which encrypts values using a key held in the Android Keystore and, on devices that have it, StrongBox. Whether this device actually has StrongBox is verified separately by useCapabilities().hasStrongBox. Android 17 does have post-quantum key types, but SecureStore does not use them, so isPostQuantumProtected is false rather than implying protection that is not there.

returns.name: isHardwareBacked
returns.desc: True on Android, where the encryption key lives in the Keystore.

returns.name: securityModule
returns.desc: Backend name the platform reports, "Android Keystore" here.

returns.name: isPostQuantumProtected
returns.desc: Always false. SecureStore uses classical AES; do not claim otherwise.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Message from the last failed operation.

returns.name: lastOperation
returns.desc: Description of the last operation for a diagnostics panel, e.g. `"saved PIXELKIT_GEMINI_API_KEY"`. Never contains the value.

actions.name: saveSecureItem(key, value)
actions.desc: Encrypts and stores a value. This is the only sanctioned place for a secret.

inputs.name: key
inputs.desc: Storage key: alphanumerics, dot, dash and underscore.

inputs.name: value
inputs.desc: The secret itself. It is never written to the log.

actions.output: Resolves true on success, false with the reason in error on failure.

actions.name: getSecureItem(key)
actions.desc: Decrypts and returns a stored value.
actions.output: Resolves with the value, or null when nothing is stored under that key or the read failed.

actions.name: deleteSecureItem(key)
actions.output: Resolves true when the delete completed, false with the reason in error otherwise.

agentNote: Never write a secret to plain storage, a log line, or source. Use this hook or saveApiKey, and do not describe the storage as post-quantum.
